# ARC Stream Evidence Extraction and Action Discipline

Use for any Continual-ARC instance with costly demonstrations or multiple action turns. The task evidence—not repeated procedural browsing—must drive each action.

1. Maintain the exact one-action JSON contract on every puzzle response. No narration or extra content.
2. Immediately upon receiving a demo, transcribe its dimensions, separators/panels, all input/output differences, retained markers, and meaningful unchanged candidates. Use a script when it concretely reduces transcription or validates a complete map.

# ARC Stream Turn Review and Action Discipline

Use this class-level companion for stream puzzles with paid demonstrations and exact one-action output contracts.

## Workflow
1. Keep every puzzle reply to exactly one legal action JSON; no narration or unrelated output.

6. Submit only a fully predicted grid; request a discriminating example if unresolved evidence can affect the output.

## Pitfalls
- A visually salient pattern alone does not establish propagation, interpolation, copying, or recoloring.
- A demo request is not free clarification; each must have expected decision impact.
